events.name: tp-dialog-close
events.description: Emitted when the dialog is closed from one of its actions.

dependencies.name: tp-button
dependencies.summary: Button component that supports native button and link rendering.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-dialog>` element implements the <tp-icon name="dialog" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Dialog functionality: displays a confirm/cancel dialog.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Activate the page's trigger to open the panel. |
| Using the component | Use its controls or links, then close it with the available dismissal control. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Dismiss the panel when its settings allow it. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
